title: GovernanceEvent
description: SAIA-Class S governance event representing an action, request, or state transition within the Beast System 3.0 governance architecture.

eventId.description: Unique identifier for the governance event (UUID recommended).

eventType.description: Type of governance event (e.g., DECISION_REQUESTED, DECISION_ISSUED, POLICY_UPDATED, IDENTITY_CHANGED).

actor.description: Snapshot of the actor context at the time of the event.

case.description: Snapshot of the case context at the time of the event.

environment.description: Snapshot of the environment context at the time of the event.

payload.description: Event-specific payload (decision request, policy update, identity change, etc.).
